facts.value: Do not travel or change employers while your STEM OPT Extension application is pending.
Submit form I-983 for the new STEM employer and complete the STEM OPT Employment Update eForm.

Go to the MyISSC eForm Portal, click on F-1 STEM OPT, choose the STEM OPT Employment Update eForm, and select 'yes' for the question about your STEM Extension application and choose 'Change to a new job – STEM OPT still pending'.
Your SEVIS record will be updated to reflect the reported changes and an updated I-20 will be issued.

Upload your new I-20 in the Unsolicited Evidence section of your STEM OPT application in the USCIS portal along with a cover letter that includes information about your change in employment and the E-Verify number of your new employer.
You are still in F-1 immigration status and must follow regulations to maintain your status.
Upload a copy of your STEM OPT EAD card in the MyISSC eForm portal after receiving it.
